_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 80: 2-4 July 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He discusses footage he calls ominous and spooky attributed to China and says they are going to watch it in October though he does not know what it is, and that when he was praying he saw weapons of war created out of satellites that would create earthquakes.
mentions.quote: I saw weapons of war created out of satellites that would create earthquakes
mentions.falsify_match: An orbital system credibly shown to induce earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reachable. The mechanism is not something that could be confirmed or denied by any public source, and the October marker attaches to the footage rather than to the weapon.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that they are aiming at the 2028 election but are more focused on this midterm and feel they have it, that it is about flipping the presidency too, and that he sees a divide trying to make him a martyr for their cause, saying he is too far left.
mentions.quote: I see a divide trying to make him a martyr
mentions.falsify_match: Same as the telling nine days later.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing new. Word-for-word restatement of the passage recorded from 13 July, which places the original here on 4 July.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks all six thousand present for coming to pray and taking time out of their Fourth of July celebration, and says he will let them go before noon to be with their families after an hour and a half of prayer.
mentions.falsify_match: The stated attendance matching the platform's own figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figure is inflated. Nothing is forecast, but the number is stated on a platform that publishes its own counts, so it is one of the few quantities in this corpus that can be checked directly.

mentions.claim_text: He welcomes to the family all twenty-nine who gave their heart to Jesus Christ today, repeats the figure, says the Lord told him to give an altar call and that he found that interesting, and sends them off to their plans for the day.
mentions.quote: 29 people gave their heart to Jesus Christ today
mentions.falsify_match: The daily tallies being internally consistent across broadcasts.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. These figures accumulate across the corpus and can be summed and compared to the totals he gives elsewhere, which is a genuine internal check.

mentions.claim_text: He opens the broadcast, thanks the family for joining, says they will go over some of the things the Lord showed them yesterday in prayer and then jump in the river, notes that many have things to do because America is getting ready to celebrate the Fourth of July, and wishes America a happy birthday.
mentions.quote: we'll go over some of the things the Lord showed us yesterday in prayer
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: an opening with nothing claimed.

mentions.claim_text: He says that over this time frame he saw an acceleration of things, of elders going home and of a cleansing of the church, breaks off to turn off his phone, and works out the window aloud as July 3rd to December 3rd then June then January 3rd, settling on the first part of next year.
mentions.quote: an acceleration of things of elders going home, of a cleansing of the church
mentions.falsify_match: Church scandals and deaths among older ministers rising over the six months.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is a fifth timing for the cleansing, and the end date is arrived at on air by trial and error, December then June then January. Elders going home is satisfied by ordinary mortality.

mentions.claim_text: He challenges them to stretch themselves to believe outside their box and to believe God for bigger as they go into the Fourth of July weekend, and points to what God did for a nation that dedicated itself to him and put in God we trust on its currency.
mentions.quote: stretch yourself to believe outside of your out of your box
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation with no stated outcome.

mentions.claim_text: He says something will keep him out of the White House in the days ahead, that he saw a scandal trying to happen that would make people veer away from JD Vance, that he saw a mole turning their back on JD Vance and a splitting of this, that Marco Rubio and Byron would have to do something, that people did not want to touch JD Vance because they did not want the scandal, and that he saw this would try to manifest around 2027 and 2028.
mentions.quote: I saw a mole turning their back on JD Vance
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal that ends Vance's presidential prospects, with Rubio and Donalds moving.
mentions.falsify_miss: No scandal and no such movement. Three named living people and a two-year window makes this one of the more checkable political claims in the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says something about exposing darkness happened yesterday, that this should encourage them that what they are praying about is exposing the darkness, and declares that the plans, the plots and the pursuits of every one of these terrorists and of the people foreign and domestic in the nation will be uncovered.
mentions.quote: the plans, the plots, the pursuits of every one of these terrorists
mentions.falsify_match: Plots uncovered and attributable to the prayers.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Every plot uncovered anywhere counts toward it and none uncovered counts against it, since the declaration has no end date and no named target.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw something go up high like a new building with Trump at the top, asks whether it means a real building and answers that it is a metaphor, that he saw a thing doubling and tripling over Trump's wealth, and that they have now announced he made two billion dollars in 2025, which goes with what the Lord showed them.
mentions.quote: I saw a thing doubling tripling over Trump's wealth
mentions.falsify_match: A reported doubling or tripling of the president's net worth.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reported figure does not double it. He asks himself whether the building is real and answers that it is a metaphor, which means the image cannot fail on its own terms; the two billion is a public figure and the doubling can be checked against prior estimates.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is going to restore back the wealth and he saw a major move, notes the president talking about making the chips himself and that Taiwan took almost a hundred per cent of the business and he has them all moving back, and reports that when he was praying the president said he needs two years and in two years they will not need Taiwan any more.
mentions.quote: I need two years, and in two years, we don't need Taiwan anymore
mentions.falsify_match: American chip capacity replacing Taiwanese supply by mid-2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. A hard two-year deadline on a measurable industrial quantity, which makes this properly scoreable. Note it also cuts against the Taiwan invasion claims: two years of dependence removed would change what an invasion costs.

mentions.claim_text: He says that concerning the United States of America in 2028 he heard impeach, impeach, impeach, but they did not have enough votes to impeach him or to go after him further, though it was enough to keep him out of the presidency because people did not want to touch it, and that he saw the African-American man with chubby cheeks, named as Byron, and the Secretary of State Rubio.
mentions.quote: I heard impeach, impeach, impeach, but they didn't have enough votes to impeach him
mentions.falsify_match: An impeachment attempt that fails on votes but ends a presidential bid.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attempt, or one that succeeds. Both outcomes of a vote are covered in advance: not enough to impeach, but enough to keep him out. That is the hedge, stated in one sentence.
